comments.author: Rogue23
comments.body_html: Dude, I just have to say, this “Oops! All Boss PMCs!” mod is absolutely insane! You’ve seriously outdone yourself with this one. Every raid feels like a massive boss fight, and it totally cranks up the adrenaline. It’s crazy how every PMC feels like a real threat now, and it makes the game so much more intense and exciting. I’m loving how it completely changes the dynamic of Tarkov, and it’s exactly the kind of challenge I’ve been looking for. Seriously, bro, you’ve turned Tarkov into a whole new beast. Big thanks for creating this, it’s beyond fun! Keep up the good work man cant wait to see what else you bring.
